ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark/black) pixels across approximately 90% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are localized at the distal tips and in sparse focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid dark low-intensity field across the main body of both lobes; high-contrast white clusters mapped to the extreme distal tips and along portions of the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an interior angle of approximately 65 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and serrated continuous boundary; presence of multiple deep valleys and sharp peaks, most notably a prominent macro-notch located roughly at the midpoint of the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge from the median notch to the tips; tips are sharply tapered and exhibit an upward-pointing trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, irregular clusters of high-contrast white circular and semi-circular pixel groups localized heavily at the terminal ends of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, thin, low-contrast linear pixel disruptions visible primarily on the inner region of the left lobe, oriented in diagonal trajectories.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular erosion and large-scale indentations along the trailing edge; heavy accumulation of high-intensity white material/scarring at the distal extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast rectangular border at the bottom containing alphanumeric text: 'JAC90-31/18 ID 10070', 'JOHN CALAMBOKIDIS', 'S# Z22', and handwritten characters 'ridging has slightly changed'.
